text: わての　ポケモン　コレクション　みに　きたの　ちゃうんか？

structure.jp: わての　ポケモン　コレクション

patterns.name: 〜に (purpose)
patterns.explanation: に after the short stem of a verb, followed by a verb of coming or going, tells what you came or went to do. みに　きた = 'came to see'.

patterns.name: 〜のではないか
patterns.span: きたの　ちゃうんか
patterns.explanation: This is the Kansai way of saying のではないのか: ちゃう stands for ではない, and んか asks the question with a little push. It checks something the speaker assumed was true. きたの　ちゃうんか = 'isn't it that you came?'
